[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Ice Cliff Chasms]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Ice Cliff Chasms in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 3,500 [[Norn rank|Norn reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Ice Cliff Chasms in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."''
